codes: 1 through 48, each used once across the complete cohort in position order
qualification: Only native frame skipping changes between paired cases on the same new binary. Both arms use a 500 kbit/s target, stream stats and direct pong dispatch. Source counter/texture phase progresses across the cohort; no identical-pixel or matched-quality claim. Marker cadence is not whole-frame fidelity or scanout. The independent ordered wire hook precedes production dispatch.
audio_latency_eligibility: No observer/video failure or overflow; all source commands confirmed; each serial submission <=100ms late; preexisting or ambiguous output excluded. Missing/late responses remain failures.
video_marker_eligibility: All counted paint markers must validate. Distinct source-marker counters per exact six-second browser window describe marker cadence, not scanout or whole-frame fidelity.
control_summary: Twenty fixed probe slots; raw wire receipt and client dispatch cutoffs are independent. Missing submissions/replies retained; only complete sets support an overall p95.
cpu_eligibility: Stable native/guest identities and complete browser endpoint set; independent midpoint acquisition windows.
sequence_eligibility: All received GLV1 IDs within each window are contiguous modulo u32, with zero decode errors and valid source-counter paint markers. Skips emit no wire packet and consume no ACK credit.
skip_counter_scope: Cumulative per-session native_skipped_frames samples during the exact browser window; absent in disabled arms, never inferred as zero. Counter changes within the window are a lower bound because sampling is once per second.
